Intro: Ho ho, a fellow chef of these mistreated streets. How do you procure your produce? I, for one, like to catch my rats fresh from the sewers.
Those pesky little rodents are hard to snatch, but they are both plentiful and nutritious. I have mastered this trade to become the best chef in the city.
I know how to make all kinds of dishes with my rats. Fifty-two exactly. I'm curious if my competition is any better.
The previous owner of this store was nothing but a sham. Do you have the skill to match my passion?
Success: ...hmph. Seems you know your stuff. From here on out, we are rivals, me and you. Let's see who emerges as the greatest chef.
Fail: Looks like I have nothing to fear. This is somehow worse than even sewage stew!
Reject: You rotten rival. You think having Svetka handle your competition makes you a good chef? One day, justice will come, and you will see those shackles yourself!
